title: Nuclei Isolation from Fresh and Frozen Tissues for snRNA-Seq and snATAC-Seq
author: Luciano G Martelotto
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bw52pg8e
materials: Use same slide to inspect under the microscope.

steps.title: Tissue Mincing
steps.instruction: Mince or chop tissue into small pieces (approximately 2-3 grains of cooked rice) using a razor blade.

steps.title: Initial Lysis
steps.instruction: Add chilled Nuclei EZ Lysis Buffer (+ RNAse inhibitor) to the tissue in a 1.5 ml DNA LoBind tube.

substeps.instruction: Use 300 µL for small pieces, or 300 µL — 500 µL for larger pieces.

steps.title: Homogenization
steps.instruction: Homogenize the sample using a douncer or pestle with approximately 10-15 gentle strokes.

substeps.instruction: The tube may be removed from ice for mincing, but must be returned to ice quickly.

steps.title: Lysis Incubation
steps.instruction: Bring the total lysis buffer volume to 1 mL, mix gently (bore tips preferred), and incubate on ice for at least 5 minutes.

steps.title: Filtration and Collection
steps.instruction: Filter the homogenate through a 70 μm-strainer mesh (e.g., pluriStrainer Mini 70 μm, pluriSelect 43-10070-40, or Flowmi® Cell Strainer).

substeps.instruction: Collect the flow-through in a 15 ml Falcon tube.
Transfer the collected volume back into a new 1.5 ml DNA LoBind tube.

steps.title: First Nuclei Wash
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the nuclei at 500 x g for 5 minutes at 4 °C.

substeps.instruction: Remove supernatant, leaving approximately 50 µL.
Add 1 mL of Nuclei Wash and Resuspension Buffer and gently resuspend the pellet (1-2 pipette strokes).

steps.title: Second Nuclei Wash
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 500 x g for 5 minutes at 4 °C.

substeps.instruction: Remove supernatant, leaving approximately 50 µL.
Add 1 mL of Nuclei Wash and Resuspension Buffer without resuspending the pellet.

steps.title: Final Nuclei Wash
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 500 x g for 5 minutes at 4 °C.

steps.title: Nuclei Resuspension and Staining
steps.instruction: Resuspend the nuclei in 200 µL - 400 µL Nuclei Wash and Resuspension Buffer supplemented with DAPI/7-AAD/DRAQ-7.

substeps.instruction: Wash the walls of the centrifuge DNA LoBind tube to collect all nuclei.
Protect the sample from light from this point forward.

steps.title: Pre-sorting Filtration and Inspection
steps.instruction: Filter nuclei at least once with a 40-μm cell strainer (e.g., Falcon® Round-Bottom Tubes with Cell Strainer or Flowmi® Cell Strainer).

substeps.instruction: Visually inspect nuclei integrity under a microscope.
Optionally count nuclei using a hematocytometer or Countess II FL Automated Cell Counter.

steps.title: Cytometric Analysis and Sorting
steps.instruction: Perform cytometric analysis to identify single nuclei and sub-populations based on DNA content.

substeps.instruction: Optionally dilute the sample to achieve ~150-200 events/second for better defined peaks.
Gate and sort nuclei directly into a round-bottom 96-well plate containing RT Buffer (without RT Enzyme).
For snRNA-Seq, sort 35-40% more nuclei than aimed (e.g., sort ~12,000 for a recovery of ~5,000) to account for FACS overestimation.

steps.title: snRNA-Seq Processing
steps.instruction: Proceed immediately with the 10x Genomics Single Cell 3' v3 or 5' protocol (Standard or NextGEM).

substeps.instruction: Add RT Enzyme to the sorted nuclei in RT buffer (10 µL for 5' kit; 8.3 µL for 3' v3 kit).
Mix well but gently and load the chip according to the Reagents User Guide.

steps.title: snATAC-Seq Sorting
steps.instruction: While the RT reaction is running, sort as many nuclei as possible into a round-bottom 96-well plate containing 50 µL of ice-cold ATAC Wash Buffer-Dig.

substeps.instruction: Do NOT sort into Diluted Nuclei Buffer.

steps.title: ATAC Wash Preparation
steps.instruction: Transfer nuclei to a 0.2 ml LoBind PCR tube.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 µL of chilled ice-cold ATAC Wash Buffer-Dig (or Diluted Nuclei Buffer).
Transfer any remaining nuclei to the 0.2 ml LoBind PCR tube (approx. 250 µL).

steps.title: First ATAC Wash Cycle
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the nuclei at 500 x g for 5 minutes at 4 °C.

substeps.instruction: Carefully remove supernatant leaving 10 µL — 15 µL (use P200 then P20) without disturbing the pellet.
Gently add 200 µL ice-cold Diluted Nuclei Buffer without resuspending nuclei.

steps.title: Second ATAC Wash Cycle
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the nuclei at 500 x g for 5 minutes at 4 °C.

substeps.instruction: Carefully remove supernatant leaving 10 µL — 15 µL without disturbing the pellet.
Gently add 200 µL ice-cold Diluted Nuclei Buffer without resuspending nuclei.

steps.title: Final ATAC Wash and Recovery
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the nuclei at 500 x g for 5 minutes at 4 °C.

substeps.instruction: Remove supernatant in two steps (P100/P200 then P20), leaving 7 µL — 10 µL. Alternatively, resuspend the pellet in 5 µL of Diluted Nuclei Buffer and skip counting.
Resuspend nuclei in the remaining 7 µL — 10 µL of ice-cold Diluted Nuclei Buffer, washing the tube walls.

steps.title: ATAC Nuclei Counting
steps.instruction: Take 1 µL — 2 µL of the resuspension and dilute 1:5 with Diluted Nuclei Buffer.

substeps.instruction: Mix 1:1 with Trypan Blue and count using a hematocytometer or Countess II FL Automated Cell Counter.

steps.title: ATAC Library Preparation
steps.instruction: Take 5 µL of nuclei in Diluted Nuclei Buffer and proceed to the Chromium Single Cell ATAC Reagent Kits protocol (CG000168 Rev A).

substeps.instruction: To estimate recovered nuclei, use the calculation: [Nuclei Concentration x Volume of Nuclei (up to 5 μl)] / 1.53.
